[LERR.9.4] **Built in and reserved.** Both schemas exist in every program
without a declaration, and a rule may pattern on either. Their names are
reserved words of the type namespace ([LLEX.9.6], [LGRA.22.7]): an author
schema declared under either name is a compile error,
`DS_VALIDATE_RESERVED_TYPE_NAME` ([LLEX.9.5]). Both are `scope internal`
([LSCP.2.6]): only the engine asserts them, an `emit` of either is
`DS_VALIDATE_INTERNAL_EMIT_FORBIDDEN` ([LSCP.2.6.1]), and a rule may `withdraw`
one it matched ([LERR.9.5]).
